_comment: JSON that intentionally differs from the compiled ui_*.c, re-applied by
tools/gen_json_from_c.py after every regeneration.  Keys are
"<screen>/<slash separated path inside the screen JSON>"; values replace
whatever the generator derived.  Only add entries that were verified on
hardware and have no counterpart in the C source.

home_screen._why: The compiled UI never reacts to taps on the WiFi symbol (lv_UserPeram only repaints it), but the JSON UI must open the WiFi configuration screen.
